_help: Optional extras for a Guardian's wiki page, keyed by Guardian name. Most story text comes from story.md automatically; use this for things the doc does not have. Fields: image (path or URL, e.g. images/blossom.png in wiki/), caption, quote, quoteBy, summary, appearance, personality, history, abilities, relationships, trivia (list), sections ([{title, text}]). Text: blank line = new paragraph, '- ' = bullet, **bold**, *italic*, [[Name]] links a Guardian.

_example.caption: Luma Blossom in Guardian form
_example.quote: A line she is known for.
